requests.chat: POST /api/chat with message "I'm at a small restaurant and I'm vegetarian. What should I say?"

answers.chat: {"reply": "To ensure your meal is strictly vegetarian, inform the server that you don't eat meat, poultry, or seafood. In Tamil Nadu, specifying 'pure veg' or 'saivam' is the standard way to get completely vegetarian food.", "phrases": [{"english": "I am vegetarian.", "translation": "நான் சைவ உணவாளி.", "romanization": "Nāṉ caiva uṇavāḷi.", "pronunciation": "NAAN SAI-va oo-na-VAA-lee", "note": "tells them you follow a vegetarian diet."}, {"english": "Do you have pure vegetarian food?", "translation": "இங்கே சுத்தமான சைவ உணவு கிடைக்குமா?", "romanization": "Iṅkē cuttamāṉa caiva uṇavu kiṭaikkumā?", "pronunciation": "ing-GAY SOO-tha-maa-na SAI-va oo-na-voo ki-DYE-koo-maa?", "note": "Use to confirm if the eatery is completely vegetarian."}, {"english": "Does this have egg or meat?", "translation": "இதுல முட்டை இல்லனா கறி இருக்கா?", "romanization": "Itula muṭṭai illaṉā kaṟi irukkā?", "pronunciation": "ithu-LA MOOT-tai il-la-NAA KA-ree i-ROOK-kaa?", "note": "Ask if you want to verify ingredients in a specific dish."}, {"english": "Please bring pure vegetarian food only.", "translation": "சுத்தமான சைவ உணவு மட்டும் கொண்டு வாருங்கள்.", "romanization": "Cuttamāṉa caiva uṇavu maṭṭum koṇṭu vāruṅkaḷ.", "pronunciation": "SOO-tha-maa-na SAI-va oo-na-voo MUT-toom KON-doo VAA-roong-gal", "note": "Polite instruction when placing your order."}], "tips": ["In Tamil Nadu, restaurants marked as 'Pure Veg' or 'Saivam' do not serve meat, eggs, or seafood.", "Most traditional vegetarian meals (Meals/Thali) in Tamil Nadu are served on a fresh banana leaf."]}
